title: Baby Tracker Diaper Weekly Hours Since Last Trend
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=babytracker:diaper hours_since_last=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(hours_since_last) as avg_duration, max(hours_since_last) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst hours since last for Baby Tracker diaper events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture hours_since_last on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average hours since last with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts whether Baby Tracker diaper tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
